chapter: Pianists, the district and Stormy Weather
title: Stormy Weather, his habits and his family
summary: He played with a pianist called Stormy Weather in the district, who drank heavily; the interviewers seek his sister.

story.theme_name: Drink, drugs and the bandstand's casualties
story.community_name: Drugs and drink on the bandstand and the road

blocks.x: He wrote the Big Buck Blues. Did you know it was Stormy Weather?

Stormy Weather? Yeah. He used to plant Stormy Weather. Stormy Weather used to hire me to play with him. In the district. And we used to play back at Bradshaw's place on Paris. Stormy Weather, he died. He was living on Colorado between Derby and Bowman. I said, collect a lot of trade his house.
What do you know about him? What else?
That's all I know about him. I know he drank a lot. Did he smoke much?

He smoked cigarettes. I never known him was smoking weed or nothing. Because he was never. I can tell a guy who smoked weed. He was looking right in his eye. And what he drinks? Salt drinks. Ornge juice. And all that kind of stuff. I'd tell right away. I'd make a damn good dictator jazz. For the smoke. They got some boys around there where I go by the shoemakers. They ain't gonna like that. Trolls that was smoking. Trolls have a school.
What was Stormy Weathers' name? Did you know? Never knew his name. That's all I know, Stormy Weathers. That's all I've been here.
Did you know his family? Huh? Did he have a family here in New Orleans?
Yeah, he had a sister. I used to collect a lot of trash at his house on Carlisle Street.
Where does his sister live? You know? She's still alive?
Carltown between Dome and Ole and South Bay. Right across the street from the Coliseum. Mike found her.
He was a little scared of chocolate and bite me every minute like that. Did you ever hear the name Game Kid? Huh? Game Kid? Game Kid? Uh-huh. Josuke Adams?

I know that Trump played there too. Bright Boy. Used to play with us down there at the Lutches. What? Pete. Huh? Pete. Pete. Pete. No, not Pete. I never did play with Pete. I know Pete. I used to go to Pete's house and collect the I-
Over the river when I was riding over the river.
